title: Run commercetools migration 34 (reactionaryProtocolData field), then re-verify protocol e2e
description: Live UCP/ACP order journeys fail: payment create is rejected with "Field definition for 'reactionaryProtocolData' does not exist on type 'reactionaryPaymentCustomFields'". The workspace Lambdas (PR #24, merged as 5716d74) are deployed, but migration 34 (composable-commerce-base-workspace libs/commercetools-data/src/lib/migrations/34-reactionary-payment-protocol-data.ts) was not applied. Run 'npx nx run commercetools-data:apply' in the workspace, then re-run 'npx vitest run --project node examples/node/src/protocols' from the reactionary root (root .env must be loaded — running from examples/node skips everything).

title: Verify and commit payment protocol data round-trip refactor
description: Run vitest for payment-protocol-data.spec.ts, npx nx affected:build and affected:lint, then commit the five changed files on feat/agentic-payment-tokens.

title: Fix protocol data value typing to match PaymentProtocolDataSchema (value: string)
description: parseProtocolDataField in packages/commercetools/src/core/payment-protocol-data.ts returns value: unknown, but PaymentProtocolDataSchema requires value: z.string() and checkout.factory.ts asserts satisfies PaymentInstruction. Keep string values as-is, JSON.stringify non-string JSON values; type serializeProtocolData input as {key, value: string}[].
